name: HSWM Ragnarok research project
canonical_role: Measure whether static semantic harness and research-protocol burden is displaced by outcome-bound HSWM learning as capability and composition scale.
conceptual_delta: Turns the USER_PRIMARY Ragnarok warning into a multimetric local-to-HSWM-of-HSWMs falsification program without treating necessary constitutional invariants as cognitive rule burden.

fcl_scope.boundary: Ragnarok measurements test burden displacement under these laws; they do not replace or establish any FCL law.

sources.title: Hidden Technical Debt in Machine Learning Systems
sources.claim_boundary: Scientific bridge only; not evidence for LX3 Ragnarok or HSWM efficacy.

hypotheses.name: learned displacement
hypotheses.test: Matched-budget fresh-task comparison of static harness and outcome-bound HSWM learned arms.
hypotheses.reject_when: Quality is outside the preregistered non-inferiority margin or lower static burden is explained by hidden calls, prompts, human work, or compute.

hypotheses.name: causal ownership
hypotheses.test: Remove, shuffle, and restore the admitted HSWM revisions under fixed context.
hypotheses.reject_when: Removal does not erase the gain, restoration does not recover it, or the revision does not change later behavior.

hypotheses.name: capability scaling
hypotheses.test: Repeat the matched-budget trial across model capability levels with a frozen accounting contract.
hypotheses.reject_when: Harness interpretation share rises without proportional causally validated outcome gain.

hypotheses.name: scale closure
hypotheses.test: Compose measured HSWM units and intervene on coalition, credit, lineage, and central orchestration.
hypotheses.reject_when: The composite is only federation or central orchestration, or member credit and lineage are unrecoverable.

nonclaims: No HSWM efficacy or scientific uniqueness claim.
No authorization to restore retired governance machinery.
Repository or KG presence is not cognition, learning, or evidence.
